summary.headline: Deaths in a Foreign Land
summary.text: Astrological doctrine on deaths in a foreign land, attributed to destructive places occupied by declining stars, especially when configured with the Moon; alternative methods use the eighth place, its lord, the ascendant, and their witnesses to determine forms of death. The apparatus identifies sources in Hephaestion, Ptolemy, Dorotheus, and Firmicus Maternus.
